decisions.reason: PMID 7984195 is the pmid= query value in https://content.nejm.org/cgi/pmidlookup?...&pmid=7984195 in the url= field of a citation template. That resolver is not one of the URL shapes listed in guide 3.5, so the raw text is 'anything else' = the identifier text, which the quote gives. The URL resolves the PMID and sits in url= of a citation, so identifier_link fits. Ambiguity: the guide's role text names resolvers generally while its raw-text table names specific shapes; I followed the table for the quote and the role text for the role.
